subject: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Hi Laura — great to hear you're interested in a walk-through. I pulled a few slots this week for a 45-min live demo + Q&A: Thu 5/3 2:00pm PT, Fri 5/4 10:00am PT, or Mon 5/7 11:00am PT.

Quick note: our compliance team sometimes requires that customers complete the vendor questionnaire and NDA before we grant access to a live instance or detailed configuration review. If procurement needs that step first, we can either:
- do a 20–25 minute executive preview (no access to tenant or PII examples) this week to keep momentum, or
- pause the full technical demo until the vendor portal/NDA is complete.

Which would you prefer? If procurement needs any specific artifacts, looping in our security lead is no problem.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0179 | hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@vectorscalehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Hi Hannah — thanks for the options. Our procurement team needs the vendor questionnaire completed and an executed NDA before scheduling full technical demos with external platforms. I attached the questionnaire and the NDA request — procurement will only accept a redline-less NDA and an entry in our vendor portal.

If it's helpful, we can do an exec preview (very high level) next week, but the technical team won't be able to join until the portal is cleared.

Attaching: VectorScale_Vendor_Questionnaire_v3.docx (form), Vectorscale_NDA_signed_stub.pdf (procurement cover)

Best,
Laura
Laura Chen
Director of Clinical Platforms, VectorScale Health
laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Thanks Laura — appreciate the clarity. Karthik: can you confirm whether we can run a 25-minute exec preview that is purely slides + conceptual architecture (no tenant screenshots or data), and whether we should send any pre-read for procurement?

Monica: procurement flagged the redline/no-redline requirement — I'm attaching Redwood's standard vendor questionnaire guidance and a brief note on what we can provide before vendor-portal access.

If procurement prefers we pause, we'll send a calendar hold and follow up when the portal is complete.

— Hannah
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Hi all — we can absolutely do a 20–25 minute executive preview that stays at the conceptual level (architecture, common integration patterns, high-level performance and cost expectations). No tenant-level data or screenshots; we can replace those with sanitized examples.

Suggested slot: Tue 5/8 9:30am PT (execs), or Thu 5/10 1:00pm PT. If procurement completes the portal sooner, we can convert to a full walkthrough.

I'll prepare a 10-slide pre-read tailored to clinical use cases and a short appendix that lists what evidence procurement typically asks for (SOC 2 summary, data handling overview, key contact for security attestation).

— Karthik (SE)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Hi Laura — quick note from security: we can provide the following up-front without vendor portal access — SOC 2 Type II summary, a redacted architecture diagram, and a one-page data handling blurb. We do need a signed NDA for any handover of configuration artifacts.

If procurement wants an intake ticket in their portal, our team can submit the questionnaire on your behalf with a contact at VectorScale copied — that sometimes speeds things up. If you'd like, I can coordinate a short intake submission today.

Monica Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@vectorscalehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@vectorscalehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 May 2028 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Executive preview vs full walkthrough — vendor intake gating

Thanks, Monica and team. Procurement is insisting on the portal entry and a completed questionnaire before any scheduled technical session. They accepted the idea of an exec preview but want it to be framed as \"overview only\" and they will not sanction any technical deep-dive until the intake is processed.

Please go ahead and submit the questionnaire on our portal if you can — procurement will expect the portal ticket ID in the vendor file. We'll plan to reconvene after the portal confirms. For now, please put a tentative 60-min hold on Tue 5/22 10:00am PT (subject to procurement clearance).

Best,
Laura
